Tread on me? I’ll tread on you

For the term “tread” I first tried something combining footprints and tire treads, but couldn’t get inspired by it. Then I thought of the Gadsden flag and voilà !

About this piece

For the term “tread” I first tried something combining footprints and tire treads, but couldn’t get inspired by it. Then I thought of the Gadsden flag and voilà !

What would you do if you saw this scene from your city apartment window?
